profile.headline: Engineer, Sr. at Starbucks
profile.summary: I love crafting software solutions for the companies I work for. I believe in life-long learning and improving my craft as a developer. My projects have included building applications for international airlines, large market television/radio station websites and currently application development for a global retailer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I participate in the analysis, design and development of features and bug fixes that support Starbucks Retail Point of Sale and Production Control systems. The services and applications I work on are deployed to approximately 16k stores in North America, France, and UK.
Currently working on client applications that support Starbucks in-store registers, tablets, order status boards, and device configuration..

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I work on new features/products, enhancements, maintenance, and bug fixes of Alaska Air Group's Suite of Ground Ops/Airport Applications. My work involves C#.Net, web services, legacy VB6 coding, web application development, Xamarin mobile development, and SQL. I participated on an internal volunteer project to develop a mobile travel listing management app for our employees, called Hopper.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Creation of interactive eLearning to support multiple workgroups within Alaska Airlines and Horizon Air.

• Designed and coded a web-based training request system for the storage and management of new training requests.

• Using Flash w/ActionScript, I created applications to simulate work processes and software simulations.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
I taught Web 170  - Animation using Adobe Flash CS4 to approximately 30 students, two nights a week for Fall Quarter 2009.

• Plan course outline, lesson plans, and projects
• Provide compelling lectures
• Demonstrate programming and design exercises
• Motivate and inspire students to learn the software
• Grade tests, projects, answer questions, and provide helpful feedback to students

positions.title: Web Director
positions.description:
As Web Director:

• Responsible for technical web development of Fisher's television and radio stations.

• Worked with Vice President of interactive division and Director of Internet Sales to seek out and implement new revenue generating opportunities.

• Coordinated a large redesign project of all Fisher websites to include replacement of underlying content management system, new look, site optimization, and addition of streaming video and mobile services.  This resulted in large increases in web traffic and allowed us to be very competitive in our markets.

• Helped standardize and introduce new ad placement positions and serving technology to generate significant online revenue for the company.

• I developed two Spanish language - Univision - TV station websites in Seattle (KUNSTV.com) and Portland (KUNPTV.com).  This involved designing and coding the underlying content management system using ASP technology and creating templates and site sections to ingest Spanish content from the Associated Press.

• Directly involved in the research and integration of technologies that provide value to web visitors.  This included streaming video, podcasting, and social networking applications.

As Technical Project Manager:

• Work with Fisher Interactive team leads (Sales, Development, Content) and third parties to set all project priorities and timelines.

• Implemented Omniture Site Catalyst web analytics suite. Worked with team leaders to define analytic requirements and generate reports.

• Coded PHP application to automate video uploading to Amazon S3 storage buckets.

• Implemented Quantcast qualitative web analytics tool.

• Implemented Intense Debate commenting system to Fisher's TV web sites resulting in increases in web traffic.

• Provided web metrics analysis and data for General Manager’s monthly executive report.

• Administrator of blogging and commenting tools.

• Technical liaison for DoubleClick ad serving implementation.

positions.title: Webmaster \ Web Developer
positions.description:
• Lead developer and creator of Horizon Air’s corporate intranet, OnYourHorizon.com.

• Designed and programmed the following database driven applications for the company intranet: job postings, classified ads, and manager forums.

• Static web page creation for HorizonAir.com and AlaskaAir.com. 

• Created and produced quarterly CEO presentation using Flash technology for all 4000 employees and for the Alaska Air Group executive management team and board of directors.

• Partnered with all departments throughout the company to make sure their online needs were met to include self-publishing training, application creation, and technical assistance.

• Assisted in photography and graphics creation for both the internet and print publications which included the Leading Edge employee newspaper and the award-winning Horizon Air Inflight Magazine.

• Designed interactive and animated Flash banner advertisements for the marketing department.

• Designed and coded an On-Time Performance widget for the company intranet using dynamic Flash technology.

positions.title: Schedules Analyst
positions.description:
• Created efficient and profitable routings on all 60 aircraft lines in 40 cities throughout the Pacific Northwest and Canada with approximately 560 flights a day system wide. 

•Optimized flight connections online and with partners Alaska Airlines, Northwest Airlines, and Continental Airlines.

• Assisted in a successful aircraft fleet simplification and transition to a new graphical flight scheduling system. 

• Partnered with all departments throughout the company to ensure the schedule met everyone’s criteria including FAA required maintenance provisions.

volunteerExperiences.description: I am a volunteer manager for a Little League Tee Ball Team in North Seattle.  I use the principles of the Positive Coaching Alliance (https://www.positivecoach.org) to give my players a positive, character-building youth sports experience.
